title: O. S. Kalinovsky, Suspected Soviet Agent

page_data.en:
D-109. O. S. MALINOVSKY, SUSPECTED
SOVIET AGENT.
1929
15. 3. 29 BURAK
D-109

Form No. 2
G. 20000-T-28

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 109.
CENTRAL I. B. Station
Date....................
Date March 15, 1929）

Subject (in full) O. S. Kalinovaky, Suspected Soviet Agent.

Made by D. S. Ovsiamnikoff Forwarded by J.K. Givens A.C. (Pol)

The undermentioned person is suspected of being
a Soviet Agent and is working in conjunction with Comrade
Burak of 102 Route Vallon.
Mr. O. S. Kalinovaky Employee of Import and Export
China Lumber Coy, 80 Yangtszepoo
Road.
Resides at 80 Yangtszepoo Road.
He was seen on several occasions visiting
Comrade Burak in company with two other suspected Soviet
agents. Recently he visited Vladivostock in connection with
the timber business of the China Lumber Coy.

V. Ovsiamnikoff
D. S.

A/D.C.I.

（批：HR. 15 3/29） （批：Icor）

Copies to H.B.M.Consul,Col.Halland,Capt.Shelley and Lt.Carlson.
（批：16/3）

MALINOVSKY, O. S. - Soviet
Employee of Import and Export China Lumber Co.,
80 Yangtzepoo Rd. Resides at 80 Yangtzepoo Rd.

BURAK - Soviet
102 Route Vallon

SMP
SMP: I.O. D. 109
15 March 1929
